name: nihontekini
description: Connect Nihontekini Japanese vocabulary decks, spaced repetition and quizzes to ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Create and manage Japanese vocabulary flashcards in Nihontekini, practice difficult words with personalized quizzes, correct cards and check learning progress. Free accounts can add up to 50 cards and create 3 quizzes using AI agents per UTC calendar month; the allowance resets monthly. Studying your own cards remains free. Premium, purchased only in the Nihontekini iOS app under Me > Premium, removes these AI limits, unlocks JLPT N4–N1 decks and unlimited in-app Test me. Your cards sync to the iOS app. Connect your Nihontekini account to start; this plugin cannot purchase or manage subscriptions.
defaultPrompt: Add 20 N5 food words to a Kitchen deck.
Quiz me on the Japanese words I keep forgetting.
How many AI cards and quizzes do I have left this month?
